# Player PCM goldens

Independent fixtures for the bridge player decoders (backlog B470, PR 1a).

Generated by `scripts/player-pcm-goldens/generate.py` using reference tools
(`flac`, `ffmpeg`, and on macOS `afconvert` for big-endian AIFF). Ordinary
`go test` never runs that script.

Each `manifest.json` entry records rate, channels, valid bits, frame count and
a SHA-256 of the interleaved sign-extended int32 samples. That hash was
checked against `flac -d` / `ffmpeg` at generation time, not against the
bridge decoder. Tests then check the bridge decoder against the hash.
